channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em ato na Catedral da Sé, Haddad diz que Flávio Bolsonaro tem postura de intolerância religiosa
item.description: Fernando Haddad, PT candidate for São Paulo governor, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for a posture of religious intolerance at a public event in the Cathedral of São Paulo. The attack occurred during a speech, highlighting ideological differences between the candidates.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama Lula novamente de 'pai do Tigrinho' em Sergipe
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro referred to Lula as 'papa tigre' during a campaign rally in Sergipe, reviving a controversial jab tied to the 'tiger cub' fraud scheme. The incident underscores the confrontational tone of the 2026 presidential race, with direct attacks against the opponent.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama Lula de ‘pai do Tigrinho’ e diz que petista quer jogar pobre ‘na miséria’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro called Lula 'father of Tigrinho' and criticized the legalization of online betting, promising investments in Sergipe and criticizing the PT. He used a truck to say the PT keeps the poor in misery and made references to a possible DNA test to prove a connection with 'Tigrinho'.

item.title: O argumento de Dino para sustentar decisão sobre Nossa Senhora de Fátima
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino ruled against restricting comedian Antonio Tabet, stating that criticism of designating Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint should be protected under free speech. The decision overturned TSE orders requiring post removal and imposing a fine of R$ 30,000.

item.title: Mais uma gambiarra de Dino
item.description: Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino overturned a colleague's decision for the second time in weeks using an old case, drawing criticism over the Court's functioning.

item.title: O conselho que Fachin recebeu – e ignorou – no caso de Alexandre de Moraes
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin decided to schedule the session regarding Alexandre de Moraes' investigation for October 15th, disregarding advice to delay it after the elections. The decision arises amid a scandal involving message exchanges with banker Daniel Vorcaro, whose documents reached the STF through a legal operation. Leaked data reveals a close relationship between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and Vorcaro, which may influence Congress's stance on potential ministerial impeachment.

item.title: Nossa senhora: Tabet celebra decisão de Dino e anuncia republicação de post
item.description: Comedian Antônio Tabet praised Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino's decision to overturn the removal order of a post about Our Lady of Aparecida, stating it preserved freedom of expression and religion. Tabet announced he would republish the content, which had been taken down following an action by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The post criticized the so-called 'military family' for allegedly attacking the image of Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: Governistas querem tornar patrimônio cultural o culto a Nossa Senhora
item.description: Federal deputies Chico Alencar and Rogério Correia introduced a bill to designate the devotion to Our Lady of Aparecida as intangible cultural heritage, responding to rumors about her status as patroness. The proposal follows Flávio Bolsonaro filing complaints against 29 individuals for spreading electoral misinformation, using the initiative to highlight the role of tradition in national culture and the defense of a secular and plural state.

item.title: JB Carvalho defendeu em livro retirar NS Aparecida como padroeira do Brasil
item.description: JB Carvalho defended in 2001 book removing Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint, distinct from fake news about Flávio Bolsonaro. The pastor recorded his position in 'A Bomba', questioning legality of holiday and calling for parliamentary mobilization. Flávio and family maintain relationship with the church founded by Carvalho.

item.title: Leia a íntegra de decisão de Dino que liberou posts sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: STF minister Flávio Dino overturned a decision ordering the removal of posts critical of Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida, ensuring freedom of expression and religion. The ruling responded to a appeal by comedian Antônio Tabet, targeted by a representation from the PL after a controversial post.

item.title: TRT proíbe empresa de promover atos de campanha após almoço com Bia Kicis
item.description: Labor courts banned Sementes Três Pinheiros Seeds Ltda from promoting campaign activities after a lunch with Bia Kicis, who solicited votes during the event. The Public Ministry of Labor notified the company and obtained an injunction with daily fines of R$50,000 for non-compliance. The practice may constitute electoral harassment.

item.title: Gestora da Stock Car projeta R$ 500 milhões em faturamento em até três anos
item.description: Grupo Veloci projects revenue of R$500 million within three years, with Stock Car Pro Series expected to generate R$230 million in 2026. Brazilian motorsport grows through sponsorships and events at Nelson Piquet International Raceway, featuring renowned drivers like Felipe Massa and Lucas Di Grassi.

item.title: Bets: proibir não significa acabar com uma prática, mas torná-la ilegal
item.description: President Lula announced the ban on sports betting via 'bets', driven by electoral pressures and public rejection of the sector's rapid growth. The previous legalization aimed to regulate the market under state control but led to widespread presence of betting companies, social harm, and revenue leakage to tax havens. Critics question the lack of serious planning and the risks of criminalization without effective oversight.

item.title: Lives, cola na mão e leite condensado: Flávio incorpora símbolos de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has adopted visual and behavioral elements associated with his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, such as handwritten messages, crowd interactions, and symbolic gestures, aiming to consolidate the bolsonarista electorate ahead of the 2026 election. His strategy includes public appearances echoing his father's iconic moments and direct communication through live streams, reinforcing the narrative of political continuity. Analysts note that Flávio blends identification with his father while cultivating a softer, more unifying image compared to polarized rhetoric.

item.title: Lula chega à reta final sem impulso de popularidade visto em presidentes candidatos à reeleição
item.description: Lula enters the final stretch of the campaign without the typical popularity boost seen in previous reelection bids. Polls show government approval around 33% with no significant rise, unlike FHC, Dilma, and Bolsonaro. Political scientists cite economic and communication factors as reasons.

item.title: Flávio tem apoio discreto no meio artístico na disputa de 2026
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro struggles to secure public endorsements from artists, unlike Lula who received over 100. Some endorsements are indirect or symbolic, such as a video from singer Leonardo and Neymar signing a jersey. He also received support from digital influencers.

item.title: Comício de Lula toca “Nossa Senhora” em meio à fake news sobre Flávio
item.description: During a rally in São Miguel, São Paulo, Lula's campaign played 'Nossa Senhora' amid controversy over fake news involving Flávio Bolsonaro. The song was used before the PT candidate's walk, sparking debates about the use of pop culture in electoral campaigns.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram números de Lula nos levantamentos da última semana
item.description: Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro in first-round polls from last week but ties technically in second-round simulations. Rejection of Lula reaches 49%. Poll numbers show slight swings within the margin of error for both candidates.

item.title: Dino reverte decisão de Mendonça sobre fake news de Nossa Senhora
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino overturned a decision by André Mendonça at the TSE, keeping suspended a post by comedian Antonio Tabet that spread a fake news story about Our Lady of Aparecida, shared by Lula supporters. The ruling aims to protect free speech and prevent religious misinformation.

item.title: Saiba como as bets adoeceram e endividaram os brasileiros
item.description: The ban on online betting in Brazil brought relief to cases like Kaio's, who lost his car, home and job due to gambling addiction. MP 1394 revoked provisions of Law 13.756, which had regulated online betting five years after its initial approval, highlighting the social and psychological impact of the practice.

item.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça que removeu posts sobre falso apoio de Flávio a ‘tirar padroeira’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino overturned a TSE decision that had ordered the removal of fake posts claiming Senator Flávio Bolsonaro supported a bill to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of her title as Brazil’s patron saint. The false story, widely shared online, was first reported by a TV network and later corrected, but it sparked backlash and mutual accusations among candidates. It ranks as the third-largest misinformation episode in the 2026 election cycle.

item.title: Ato da esquerda em SP adota discurso religioso após disputa sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: Left-wing candidates in São Paulo held a Mass at the Cathedral and a women's rally, highlighting religion in the political agenda amid debates over Our Lady of Aparecida. The strategy aims to connect the Catholic conservative base with progressive demands.

item.title: Dino anula decisão do TSE e libera publicação sobre Nossa Senhora que causou dano a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino overturned a TSE decision and authorized publications regarding the law that designated Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint, reversing a restriction that affected Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Dino derruba decisão do TSE que mandava remover posts sobre Flávio e Nossa Senhora
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino overturned a TSE decision that ordered the removal of social media posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to criticisms against Brazil's patron saint, Our Lady of Aparecida. The controversy involved shares claiming evangelical groups sought to revise Law 6.802, an allegation denied by Bolsonaro. Dino emphasized that the debate is legitimate and that judicial restrictions on opposing expressions violate religious freedom.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram número expressivo de eleitores indecisos sobre o voto para presidente
item.description: Election polls for 2026 reveal a significant proportion of undecided voters, particularly in the spontaneous mode, with Quaest leading at 35%. The race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) remains tight, making the capture of undecided voters crucial for the final outcome.

item.title: Lula critica times de futebol e Janja faz sinal para presidente parar
item.description: President Lula criticized football clubs opposing the ban on betting houses, highlighting the support of Flamengo and other teams for the betting market. First Lady Janja intervened during the rally, playfully signaling for Lula not to mention only Flamengo, resulting in the inclusion of Corinthians and other teams in the criticism. Lula advocated for ending betting as a way to combat money laundering in football.

item.title: Proibição das bets ganha apoio nas redes, mas Lula é pouco associado à medida, aponta pesquisa
item.description: Online betting ban announced by Lula received positive social media reaction, but he is little linked to the measure, per research. The move aims to court women, a group where Lula lags. Betting was legalized under Temer and regulated by Lula in 2023, sparking election-timed criticism.

item.title: A uma semana da votação, Lula está diante dos piores cenários
item.description: A week before the vote, President Lula faces his worst scenarios yet, tied technically with Flávio Bolsonaro in both first and second-round simulations. Recent polls show Lula at 40% and Flávio at 36% in the first round, and 47% to 45% in the second round. Lula's strategy includes electoral impact measures such as a 15% increase in the Bolsa Família benefit to gain and mobilize voters, especially amid potential growing support from center-right leaders to Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Mendonça amplia influência no TCE-SP com aliados indicados por Tarcísio
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça reinforced his influence in TCE-SP through alliances with conselheiros appointed by Tarcísio de Freitas, solidifying a political base aligned with the Republican governorship. His proximity to appointees from Tarcísio’s administration (2019-2022) expanded his leverage over state fiscal and taxation decisions.

item.title: Os números de Flávio Bolsonaro nas pesquisas eleitorais divulgadas na última semana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro remains in technical tie with Lula across five national first-round polls, trailing by 2.4 to four percentage points. In second-round matchups, Flávio leads only in Quaest and Real Time Big Data polls, but both leads fall within the margin of error. Recent polls show minimal shifts for both candidates.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Lula, Gabrielli cobra estratégia para o segundo turno
item.description: José Sérgio Gabrielli, Lula's campaign coordinator, urgently demands the definition of strategies for the second round, concerned about the possibility of defeat in the first round due to Flávio Bolsonaro's good performance. The PT campaign is working at an 'all or nothing' pace to ensure victory and avoid the dispute being resolved in the first round. Among the strategic measures are a 15% adjustment to Bolsa Família, announcements of weight-loss injections in the SUS, and policies to reduce family debt.

item.title: Saiba os próximos passos do pacote de Lula para proibir as bets no Brasil
item.description: President Lula issued a provisional measure to ban online betting in Brazil, which took effect immediately but requires congressional approval within 120 days. The measure sets a timeline for shutting down platforms and returning funds to users, and includes a bill to criminalize fixed-odds betting. The legislative process involves a joint committee and votes in both chambers.

item.title: Flávio e Nossa Senhora: caso vira 3ª maior controvérsia política do ano
item.description: The case involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and the title of patron saint granted to Our Lady of Aparecida became the third-largest political controversy of the year, generating nearly 1 million social media posts. The controversy centers on potential political influence in the decision and revives debates about religion and the state in Brazil.

item.title: Destino de Alexandre de Moraes pode ficar para depois do Carnaval, avaliam ministros
item.description: The fate of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, investigated for communications with banker Daniel Vorcaro, may only be decided after Carnival 2027 due to the court recess and the October 2026 election context. Justice Flávio Dino requested a review of the case, interrupting the session and making a quick ruling unlikely. Some justices prefer to delay harsh decisions until after the 2026 elections, regardless of whether Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro wins.

item.title: Carlos Bolsonaro investiu R$ 17,9 mil para impulsionar posts perto do 7/9
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro spent R$ 17,900 to boost social media posts in September, particularly between September 5 and 8, with the highest spending on September 7, linked to pro-Bolsonaro protests. The campaign was connected to ghost profiles spreading misinformation against Lula following the September 7 demonstrations. Flávio Bolsonaro also invested R$ 39,000 in post promotions during a similar timeframe.

item.title: Plantaram Moraes, colheram Mendonça
item.description: The article discusses how insecurity generated by Lula's measures in the final stretch of the first round of elections encouraged his electorate to adopt a radical stance, including the spread of misinformation. Even after GloboNews debunked the information about a supposed evangelical movement to remove the title of patron saint of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida, Lula supporters continued to spread the lie.

item.title: Kassio derruba jingle de Lula sobre Flávio Bolsonaro com menções a Vorcaro, Queiroz e miliciano
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques suspended a campaign jingle by Lula referencing political scandals involving Flávio Bolsonaro, including mentions of Daniel Vorcaro, Queiroz, and a militia member. The ruling cited that the content exceeded the limits of admissible political-electoral criticism, potentially misleading voters about the current legal status of those involved. Until the TSE plenary rules on the matter, Lula's campaign is barred from airing the contested advertisement.

item.title: TRE suspende distribuição de panfletos e vídeo que associam JHC a Lula
item.description: The electoral judge at TRE-AL suspended the distribution of pamphlets and videos linking gubernatorial candidate JHC to President Lula, claiming it misleads voters into believing in a non-existent political alliance. The coalition led by Renan Filho challenged the legality of using Lula's image in JHC's campaign, as the PT is not part of the PSDB's local coalition. The ruling aims to ensure electoral advertising complies with officially registered alliances.

item.title: 37% avaliam o Congresso como ruim ou péssimo, diz Datafolha
item.description: A September 2026 Datafolha poll shows 37% of voters rate the National Congress as bad or very bad, while only 18% see it as good or excellent. Negative views are higher among men, higher-income individuals, and supporters of both Lula and Bolsonaro, with regional and socioeconomic disparities also noted.

item.title: As cinco forças que podem decidir a eleição (por Gaudêncio Torquato)
item.description: The 2026 presidential election between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro is tied, with high rejection rates for both candidates. Five key forces that could determine the outcome include the anti-system narrative, continuation of social programs, Bolsa Família adjustment, base mobilization, and convincing undecided voters.

item.title: Lula “esquece” região Norte e prioriza o Sudeste no 1º turno
item.description: President Lula prioritized the Southeast in his campaign for the first round, mostly visiting São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Minas Gerais, while neglecting the North, where the PT traditionally struggles. The only pre-election visit to the North was to Manaus in May, outside the electoral period. This strategy reflects a focus on decisive states, such as Minas Gerais, a swing state, rather than traditional PT strongholds.

item.title: Busca pelo Paraguai aumentou com reforma tributária, diz consultoria
item.description: The search for Brazilian companies interested in producing in Paraguay increased with the tax reform discussions and high interest rates in Brazil. Around 100 industries contacted the Frontexa consultancy in 2026, attracted by the lower tax burden and greater predictability in the neighboring country. Since 2007, over 230 Brazilian companies have moved to Paraguay under the maquila regime.

item.title: “Manobra eleitoreira”, diz Renan Santos sobre proibição das bets por Lula
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) labeled as an 'electoral maneuver' Lula's decision to ban online betting on the eve of the first round. Although he supports ending bets, he criticized the timing and form of the government's measure.

item.title: A chance de Caiado fazer campanha para Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado's circle dismissed the possibility of him campaigning for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, despite mutual criticisms between the candidates during the electoral race. The decision reflects the strategic positioning of the PSD regarding alliances in the electoral landscape.

item.title: Lula x Bolsonaro: o que diziam as pesquisas a esta altura da eleição de 2022
item.description: One week before the 2026 presidential election, polls show a tight race between President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Compared to 2022, when Lula led voter intention surveys at the end of the campaign, the current dynamic presents different scenarios but remains highly competitive between the two candidates.

item.title: Governo planeja reunião com clubes após proibição das bets
item.description: The federal government schedules a meeting on Tuesday (29) with football clubs and the CBF to discuss the impacts of the provisional decree banning online betting and advertising of betting sites in Brazil. The measure, published on Friday (25), takes effect on October 6th, affecting million-dollar contracts such as those of Flamengo (R$268.5 million/year with Betano) and Fluminense (R$52 million/year with Superbet), generating concern over revenue loss and requests for a transition period.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio após números da última semana
item.description: Recent polls show Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round, with narrow margins ranging from 1 to 3 percentage points. In second-round scenarios, surveys indicate a technical tie between the two candidates. Voting intentions for other candidates like Augusto Cury and Renan Santos remain low.

item.title: Artigo: ‘A última semana importa’, escreve Felipe Nunes, diretor da Quaest
item.description: Despite tied poll numbers between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, the electorate remains fluid and may shift before October 4th. Indecision persists, particularly in the Southeast, with events like the women-focused policy package and the strategic vote potentially swaying outcomes. The underlying movement between candidates, undecided voters, and null votes indicates that statistical stability does not mean voter immobility.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Datafolha sobre Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro, a 3 dias da eleição
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll projects a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round, with the president leading numerically at 47% to 45%. The survey, conducted with 2,506 respondents and a margin of error of two percentage points, will be released three days before the 2026 elections.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende jingle de Lula que liga Flavio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro e rachadinha
item.description: The President of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, provisionally suspended a campaign jingle by Lula that links Flávio Bolsonaro to cases of corruption, the Banco Master, and real estate purchases with cash. The decision was based on suspected electoral disinformation, since the ad may mislead voters by presenting allegations without clarifying their status. Flávio's campaign claimed the ad contained fabricated and manipulated content.
